parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating metal cover of the USB flash drive, made of aluminum for durability and protection.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the USB connector when not in use and can rotate to expose the connector for plugging in.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot point to open or close over the USB connector.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, made of ABS plastic, housing the memory chip and connector.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the electronic components and provides a surface for gripping during use.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural base for the rotating cover.
